notes.title: EBOLA VILLAGE release May 12 - new part of the franchise
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807183/c29fd6b986a517c7d98219b0b6cfe9e7f48482b6.jpg

Friends! I have great news! EBOLA VILLAGE, which I have been working on for so long, is finally finished and has undergone extensive testing. Every element has been polished as much as possible to ensure maximum fun and dynamics of the gameplay. The game maintains a smooth frame rate of 60 FPS, providing players with perfect immersion.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306030/EBOLA_VILLAGE/

In addition, we have prepared a real surprise - a film based on the game! Despite the titanic efforts and time spent on its creation, we decided to make this project absolutely free. The film will be shown on the official ROE YouTube channel. You will find a direct link to it in the main menu of the game, and we also planned to publish an announcement on the game page on Steam. The film will be available in two languages ​​- Russian and English.

Your participation and support are especially important now. Please add EBOLA VILLAGE to your wishlist on Steam, share information about the release with friends and acquaintances, and if you have contacts in the media or among popular YouTubers, tell them about this event. The more active our community is, the higher the chances of creating a full-length free film in the genre of survival horror, with a cool plot, zombies and other exciting elements. Your contribution will help not only increase sales, but also significantly improve the quality of future projects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807183/4ee027a95355e8ddf9e0200283067971d7e52112.jpg

We believe that together we can create a real gaming culture, it will be a real event for all fans of this genre!

notes.title: The release of the game in early access
notes.notes: The game is out in early access. During the next week there will be a 25% discount in gratitude for early support.

notes.title: NEW DEMO VERSION
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39807183/3ed7605709d0732335aecd4ca5f83b1b3bc3b3ed.png

A new free DEMO version of the EBOLA 3 game has appeared on the STEM page, which anyone can download. On average, the passage of the DEMO will take you 20-35 minutes.

Please note that this is not the final product, firstly, there is still a month before the release. Secondly, the game will be in "EARLY ACCESS" for at least 4 months. You can openly write about all bugs, problems and suggestions in the gaming community: LINK

Full English and Russian localization has been added to the demo version of the game.
Who tried to download the game in the morning, now you can update and everything will work.
